library.nat_ceiling_log_le_one:
lemma nat_ceiling_log_le_one:
  fixes x :: real
  assumes "0 < x" "x \<le> 1"
  shows "nat \<lceil>log 2 x\<rceil> = 0"
proof -
  have "log 2 x \<le> 0"
    using assms by (simp add: log_le_iff)
  then show ?thesis by simp
qed
library.log2_positive:
lemma log2_positive:
  fixes x :: real
  assumes "1 < x"
  shows "0 < log 2 x"
  using assms by (simp add: log_le_iff)
library.int_nat_ceiling_log:
lemma int_nat_ceiling_log:
  fixes x :: real
  assumes "1 < x"
  shows "int (nat \<lceil>log 2 x\<rceil>) = \<lceil>log 2 x\<rceil>"
proof -
  have p: "0 < log 2 x"
    using assms by (rule log2_positive)
  have c: "0 < \<lceil>log 2 x\<rceil>"
  proof -
    have "\<not> \<lceil>log 2 x\<rceil> \<le> 0"
      using p by (simp add: ceiling_le)
    then show ?thesis by linarith
  qed
  show ?thesis
    using c by simp
qed
library.nat_ceiling_log_positive:
lemma nat_ceiling_log_positive:
  fixes x :: real
  assumes "1 < x"
  shows "0 < nat \<lceil>log 2 x\<rceil>"
proof -
  have lp: "0 < log 2 x"
    using assms by (rule log2_positive)
  have cp: "0 < \<lceil>log 2 x\<rceil>"
  proof -
    have "\<not> \<lceil>log 2 x\<rceil> \<le> 0"
      using lp by (simp add: ceiling_le)
    then show ?thesis by linarith
  qed
  show ?thesis
    using cp by simp
qed
